raw: El Shaarawy S. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+8' The corner is swung in but AS Roma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+7' The ball is crossed into the box and Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the bottom left corner, but Maduka Okoye gets a glove on it to thwart him. The linesman makes the right call and AS Roma will have a corner.
90+5' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+4' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' It's time for a substitution. Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) comes on in place of Idrissa Gueye.
90+1' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) replaces Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) has a goal ruled out for offside!
89' The free kick is taken by Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma), but ball is cleared.
87' Udinese take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
85' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
84' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Good work from AS Roma as they win a corner.
81' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) commits a foul after dangerous play.
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lennon Miller (Udinese) will be replaced by Oier Zarraga.
79' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Nicolo Bertola is replaced by Christian Kabasele (Udinese).
79' Here is a change. Zeki Celik is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma).
78' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Matias Soule will be replaced by Robinio Vaz (AS Roma).
78' The referee signals a substitution. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Neil El Aynaoui.
78' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Juan Luca Sacchi stops the game and makes a call.
76' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

76' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the roof of the net, but Mile Svilar is alert and thwarts the effort. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) trips an opposition player and Juan Luca Sacchi signals a foul.
73' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
73' The resulting corner, taken by Matias Soule (AS Roma), comes to nothing.

73' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
70' Today's match ends for Mario Hermoso who will be replaced by Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma).
70' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) has tested the patience of referee Juan Luca Sacchi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
70' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
69' Lennon Miller (Udinese) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
67' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) replacing Lorenzo Pellegrini.
67' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
66' Neat passing move from AS Roma in order to create new attacking opportunities.

63' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
62' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
62' Matias Soule (AS Roma) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
61' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
56' Keinan Davis is substituted due to injury. Kosta Runjaic gives a chance to Idrissa Gueye (Udinese).
55' Keinan Davis (Udinese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
54' Great teamplay by AS Roma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
53' The game is interrupted. Lennon Miller (Udinese) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
49' 1 - 0 Goal! The free-kick is fired in by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) and the ball inadvertently flicks off a defender and spins into the net, leaving Mile Svilar stranded. 1:0.
48' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
48' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Matias Soule (AS Roma) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
44' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Luca Sacchi saw the whole situation. Another situation results in a direct free kick for AS Roma.
43' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
41' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
40' Lennon Miller (Udinese) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
39' Arthur Atta (Udinese) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
38' Juan Luca Sacchi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) and blew his whistle.
36' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
35' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) commits a foul and Juan Luca Sacchi immediately signals a free kick.
34' The ball is cleared after Matias Soule (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
33' AS Roma couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Maduka Okoye (Udinese) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
32' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) brought his opponent down. AS Roma win a free kick.
30' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Maduka Okoye easily makes the save.
27' Lennon Miller (Udinese) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
26' Keinan Davis (Udinese) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Udinese get a corner.
25' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
22' The ball possession is 48:52.
20' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
20' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. AS Roma will take a corner kick.
17' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
15' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Luca Sacchi no option but to blow his whistle.
14' Udinese are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
13' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
12' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
9' Oumar Solet (Udinese) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
9' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his long-range effort towards the left post. Brilliant save!
8' A quickly taken corner by Udinese.

8' Arthur Atta (Udinese) collects a pass and has an effort from distance to the right side of the goal, but Mile Svilar answers with a superb save to deny him. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
5' AS Roma work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
4' Matias Soule (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
3' The referee blows his whistle as Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) was too aggressive in his challenge.
1' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Luca Sacchi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Juan Luca Sacchi will supervise the game today.
